title: The Distance Between Houses
subtitle: An anatomy of a country that vanished
setting: The fictional Republic of Liora and Northern Directorate of Veyr

parts.title: The Summer of Open Doors

chapters.title: The Long Table
chapters.description: Before the first fracture, Rowan Way knows how to share a street.

chapters.title: The Department of Civic Weather
chapters.description: Across the northern sea, a psychologist receives an assignment.

chapters.title: A Very Ordinary Notification
chapters.description: A mother's campaign becomes something larger than she intended.

chapters.title: The First Silence
chapters.description: Two brothers fail to say the one thing that might save them.

chapters.title: The Shape of a Missing Person
chapters.description: A librarian discovers that the absences are spreading.

parts.description: Before anyone notices what is being taken.

parts.title: The Names We Give Our Enemies
parts.description: What happens when every familiar face acquires a side.

chapters.title: A Useful Kind of Certainty
chapters.description: Rival movements give genuine grievances the names of enemies.

chapters.title: The Second Table
chapters.description: The neighborhood tries to share supper again—and finds the chairs empty.

chapters.title: A Man Worth Listening To
chapters.description: A mechanic discovers the rewards and hidden price of a public voice.

chapters.title: The Ledger
chapters.description: Eva finds money crossing political lines, but not yet proof of who directs it.

parts.title: The Feed Between Us
parts.description: A house divided, children who learn silence, and a final shared Sunday.

chapters.title: The Separate Bedrooms
chapters.description: Mara and Tomas remain married while their house acquires a border.

chapters.title: Children of the Borderless War
chapters.description: Ivo and Tessa inherit an argument that was never theirs to begin with.

chapters.title: Official Results
chapters.description: Irena receives a promotion for claims even her own analyst cannot support.

chapters.title: The Last Shared Sunday
chapters.description: At Mrs. Kade's funeral, the neighborhood remembers how to be together.

parts.title: The Country That Hated Itself
parts.description: A lawful election, institutions coming apart, and proof the country cannot hear.

chapters.title: The Election Nobody Could Lose
chapters.description: The vote is legitimate. Winning the right to govern no longer means being believed.

chapters.title: A Republic of Small Rooms
chapters.description: Shared institutions close even as ordinary people keep trying to help.

chapters.title: The File That Crossed the Sea
chapters.description: A cautious northern analyst signs his name to evidence Eva can verify.

chapters.title: Every Fact Has Two Histories
chapters.description: The exposure is genuine; the country fractures around what it means.

parts.title: The Diagnosis
parts.description: Under the language of public safety, evidence is transformed into a symptom.

chapters.title: The Public Disorder Act
chapters.description: Real violence becomes the justification for powers that can reach the innocent.

chapters.title: A Doctor's Signature
chapters.description: One psychiatrist refuses to diagnose dissent; another signs the recommendation.

chapters.title: The House With No Street Number
chapters.description: Sela enters Eastmere, where the record describes her evidence as a symptom.

chapters.title: The Calm Report
chapters.description: Lev is pressured to retract, Eva loses her newspaper, and Veyr calls silence stability.

parts.title: The Last Country
parts.description: The republic disappears; its destroyers receive honors; the witnesses remain.

chapters.title: The Map With Fewer Names
chapters.description: The Compact formally transfers Liora's sovereign powers to a northern-led council.

chapters.title: The Medals
chapters.description: The psychologists who helped weaken a country are publicly rewarded.

chapters.title: The Empty Table
chapters.description: At seventeen, Ivo returns to the street where the country once sat together.

chapters.title: The Official Record
chapters.description: One official history declares victory while Sela remains confined.
